ops.sql: SELECT Package_ID, Name, ea_guid FROM t_package WHERE ea_guid = '{1D8CF437-9895-4d1d-90BD-09C7A3B69477}' OR Name LIKE 'FBT-ORPHAN%'
SELECT d.DocID, d.ElementID, d.DocName, d.Version, d.DocDate, LENGTH(d.BinContent) AS bytes FROM t_document d WHERE d.DocType = 'Baseline' AND d.ElementID NOT IN (SELECT ea_guid FROM t_package)
SELECT d.DocID, d.DocName, d.Version, d.DocDate FROM t_document d WHERE d.DocType = 'Baseline' AND d.ElementID = '{1D8CF437-9895-4d1d-90BD-09C7A3B69477}'
